title: Three-agent issue desk: delegation, per-user state, idempotent filing, card selections
request: Build THREE agents. 'classifier' labels an issue title: if it contains 'crash' or 'exception' (case-insensitive) the label is bug; else if it contains 'slow' the label is performance; otherwise question. 'registry' stores issues PER USER (the entry agent tells it which user): each user's issues get ids I-1, I-2, ... in order of first filing, and filing a title that user already filed returns the existing id instead of creating a new one. 'intake' is the entry agent: for 'file <title>' it asks classifier for the label and registry for the id and replies 'Filed <id> as <label>' with a review card titled 'Close <id>?' whose Approve button has selection {"action":"close","id":"<id>"} and whose Reject button has selection {"action":"keep","id":"<id>"}. When the user sends {"action":"close","id":"X"} reply 'Closed X' the first time and 'Already closed X' after that; for an id that user never filed reply 'Unknown issue X'. On {"action":"keep","id":"X"} reply 'Kept X'.
